payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the self-attention functions in the last layer of the BERT model are more relevant for analysis because they exhibit more significant changes and correlations with human attention, while earlier layers show less variation during fine-tuning.

claims.text: Self-attention functions in the last layer of BERT are more relevant for analysis due to their stronger correlations with human attention compared to earlier layers.
Fine-tuning BERT does not significantly change the correlations to human attention, indicating that the last layer's attention functions are stable and informative.
Transformers, including BERT, have attention functions that do not change significantly until the later layers, making the last layer's analysis more critical.
